justification: Adds Northern Beaches to the existing Land Application gate so Warringah DCP 2011 is served only where layer 8 names Warringah LEP 2011; Manly and Pittwater land is withheld.

pre_impl.existing_data: reads the layer-8 landApplicationInstruments the property API already returns; no table read or written
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: assumed one DCP per council; Northern Beaches has three plans and only Warringah's is loaded
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: one new entry in the existing DCP_LAND_BINDING map, same decision code as City of Sydney

functions.name: decideLandApplication
functions.output: covered / excluded / partial / unknown, with withhold flag
functions.if_none: unknown, withheld for a gated council, which shows the plan cannot be confirmed

values.guard_at: decodeLandApplication returns null for malformed input
values.if_missing: status unknown and Warringah rules withheld, never served by default

break_it.scenario: Manly lot whose layer 8 names Manly LEP 2013
break_it.what_happens: Warringah rules would be served to land they do not cover
break_it.how: binding requires the Warringah LEP name, so status is excluded

break_it.scenario: Pittwater lot whose layer 8 names Pittwater LEP 2014
break_it.how: excluded by the same binding test

break_it.scenario: council passed as display name NORTHERN BEACHES
break_it.what_happens: a slug mismatch would skip the gate silently
break_it.how: toLgaSlug normalises it; test asserts withhold for the display name

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a Manly or Pittwater layer-8 answer is not withheld, or a Warringah answer is withheld
falsifiable_check.observed_red: before the binding, 1/28A Addison Rd Manly was served 10 of 10 Warringah rules in the 2026-10-15 address audit
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Warringah DCP 2011 Part A.3 page 3: applies to all land to which Warringah LEP 2011 applies

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: /api/provisions/for-property for 1/28A Addison Road Manly returns no Warringah rules
